messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "reduce dose if not tolerated"
set: ["reduce dose if not tolerated", "reduce dosage if drowsiness develops", "re-escalate to 2.4 mg once weekly if lower dose is tolerated", "may reduce dose after adding diuretic", "reduce inflammation", "increase dosage as tolerated", "dose may go up to 50 mg once a day if tolerated", "reduce dose to 1.7 mg once weekly", "doctor may reduce dose as condition improves", "gradually reduce dosage", "your prescriber might reduce your dose of insulin or sulphonylureas if needed to reduce the risk of hypoglycemia", "do not double up if dose is not controlling symptoms", "reduce salt in diet", "increase total daily dose by 50 mg every 3 days as tolerated", "if 300 mg orally per day not tolerated, reduce to 150 mg once a day", "call healthcare provider if dose does not control pain"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
